correctness.rationale: Keeping the Guo-Hu pair and fixed point \(z_0=400/399\), the curvature numerator and denominator are quadratic functions of the mixing weight. Independent exact arithmetic reproduced the discriminant \(36000^2\cdot103288299735\) and the roots \(0.201486508538007\ldots\) and \(0.953210606835668\ldots\); the denominator has positive coefficients on \([0,1]\). Thus the same fixed point violates the strict exterior-convexity condition exactly on the displayed interval. The source's weighted Laurent-tail argument extends to every convex mixture and keeps the family in \(\Sigma\).
residual_risks: The interval classifies only failure detected at the fixed source test point; mixtures outside it may fail convexity elsewhere.
